description: Build a transparent scenario-based DCF analysis with an enterprise-to-equity bridge and sensitivities; it is decision support, not an investment recommendation.

routing.when_to_use: Use when explicitly requested to prepare a DCF intrinsic-value scenario model from sourced historical financials and owner-approved assumptions.
when_not_to_use: A different atomic task has its own skill
Requested output is an unapproved action or external effect
exclusion_rules: No system mutation or external communication
ambiguity_rules: Continue unaffected work and request only facts that materially change the result

required_inputs.name: scope_and_source_inputs
required_inputs.description: entity/security, valuation date and currency; 3–5 years sourced financials; share/debt/cash data where equity bridge requested; approved revenue/margin/tax/D&A/capex/NWC assumptions; projection horizon; discount-rate inputs/method; terminal method; diluted shares; scenario definitions; intended decision owner.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: historical metric bridge; Bear/Base/Bull assumptions; unlevered FCF schedule; WACC/discounting; terminal and EV-to-equity bridge; sensitivity tables and source/assumption log.

forbidden_actions: Mutation of company, fund, Odoo, accounting, payroll or source records
Payments, filings, signatures, publications, messages, approvals, trades or transaction commitments
Inventing current law, jurisdiction, entity/fund applicability or missing facts
verification_steps: 1. Confirm enterprise-vs-equity valuation, date, currency, entity, audience and approved data scope. Obtain historical actuals and current market inputs only from cited primary/authorized sources; do not invent company facts. 2. Reconcile 3–5 historical years for revenue growth, gross/EBIT margins, D&A, capex and working capital; distinguish reported values from normalized adjustments. 3. Build explicit Bear/Base/Bull annual drivers. Each projected number is formula-derived from prior period/assumptions; show growth, margins and capex/NWC logic. 4. Calculate EBIT, taxes using supplied applicable rate assumption, NOPAT, D&A, capex and delta NWC to unlevered FCF. Preserve sign conventions and source/assumption refs. 5. Compute cost of equity and after-tax debt cost only from supported inputs; show CAPM components, market-value capital weights and WACC. If weights or beta/risk-free rate are not sourced, show scenario parameter rather than calling it current WACC. 6. Discount explicit FCFs with stated period convention. Terminal value: perpetuity FCF_next/(WACC−g) or terminal EBITDA×multiple; require WACC>g for perpetuity and expose terminal-method choice. 7. Bridge PV explicit FCF + PV terminal value = EV; subtract net debt and other documented claims to equity; divide by diluted shares only if share basis supported. 8. Build sensitivity cells by recomputing the valuation for each assumption combination; center case must tie to base case. Show 2-variable combinations and units; avoid linear approximations. 9. Check signs, formula links, bridge arithmetic, sensitivity center, WACC vs g, and terminal value dependence. source WACC ranges, terminal-value share guidelines and tax-rate heuristics are not company facts or hard validation cutoffs. 10. Return model-ready tables and decision caveats; no security transaction, promise, external filing or share issuance.
Show formulas/denominators, evidence dates and assumptions; preserve unresolved conflicts.
Write only a requested private draft; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Conditional task scope is evidenced or limitations explicitly bound
Task method and calculation are reproducible from cited inputs
Owner decisions, open issues and source limitations are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
